module: Debug extension that sends JSON packets over UDP to an external tool (AED, 'Advanced External Debug') on 127.0.0.1:43812, at 30 sends per second, with a heartbeat planned at 1 Hz. Vehicle modules drop their packets there via debugPacket; the extension adds to each frame a main packet indicating whether this vehicle is the player's.
notes: Each packet receives vehicleID = objectId. Pending packets are sent as a single JSON array every 1/30 s (jsonEncode(debugPackets)), then the list is cleared.

At load and at onInit: creates a non-blocking UDP socket (if the global `socket` exists), points to 127.0.0.1:43812 (peerIP and peerPort are hardcoded, debugSettings is an empty table) and records a packet {sourceType='AED', packetType='init'}.

Receiving commands (RequestConfig, EnableDebugMode, SetConfig, SetProperty) is coded but disabled: the call receiveDebugCommands() is commented out in updateGFX. If enabled, it would use `subControllerLookup`, a variable that is not defined anywhere in this file.
sendDebugHeartbeat (sending the string 'BNGAED') is defined but never called.
If udpSocket:send fails, the error is printed (print) at each attempt.

onInit.desc: Initialization hook: creates the UDP link and signals a new vehicle to the tool.

onReset.desc: Reset hook: clears the packet queue.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension loads: calls onInit.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: adds the main packet then sends the accumulated packets at 30 Hz.

debugPacket.desc: Adds a packet to the send queue (vehicleID is added automatically).

packet.desc: JSON-serializable table, preferably with sourceType and packetType.
